Product Features

  • LED Coffee Table: The combination of high-gloss black finish and colorful LED lights, modern simplicity and light come together to make this coffee table look even more unique and charming.
  • Plenty of storage: This coffee table has four storage compartments and a hidden storage space when you pull out the top plate. The hidden design allows you to design the storage space to your liking. The powerful storage function can meet your daily storage needs and make your home more organized.
  • STRONG CONSTRUCTION: This coffee table is made of high-quality chipboard, which is sturdy and durable, easy to clean.
  • EASY TO ASSEMBLE: The LED coffee table comes with a detailed guide that includes all the accessories necessary for installation so that you can assemble it faster. If there is any problem with the product, please feel free to contact us
  • MODERN DESIGN: The high-gloss coffee table fits perfectly into modern living spaces with its timeless design and is the perfect eye-catcher for the living room or reading corner.
  • The product size is 90*55*41cm, the load capacity is 30kg.
  • DESK TABLE PULL-OUT DESIGN: The extendable tabletop can be used for various needs, for home office or daily use. It is worth noting that there will be a recessed hidden storage space when the top table top is pulled out, closed storage makes the living room less cluttered
  • Click-to-open design: Four drawers are equipped with click devices. They have no handles and can be opened by simply pressing with your fingers.
  • Silky smooth pull-out: The top tabletop has noiseless sliding rails for easy pull-out
  • Versatile: The multifunctional design means that this coffee table is no longer just a living room furniture, but is suitable for different rooms, whether as a coffee table in the living room or as an office decoration.

Description

Product description: This stylish coffee table in a high-gloss look combines modern design with practical functionality and is an eye-catcher in any living room. With dimensions of 90x55x41 cm, the table offers enough space for different styles. A special highlight of this table is the integrated LED lighting, which creates a warm and cozy atmosphere and takes your home décor to a new level. Four spacious drawers provide additional storage space for magazines, remote controls or other small items you want to access quickly. The extendable design of the top tabletop makes it suitable for both the office and everyday use.
